items.question: How can I find clients for my wedding business?
items.answer: By being visible where couples actually search: Mariable lists your business to couples comparing vendors, styles and budgets. Your profile shows your services and prices, which naturally filters enquiries and brings you wedding clients aligned with your positioning.

items.question: How much does Mariable Pro cost?
items.answer: Mariable Pro costs €149/year, with no automatic renewal commitment and a free trial available. It includes unlimited projects, a multi-wedding professional workspace, wedding-day coordination, AI features and optional Mariable listing.

items.question: What wedding marketing is included in Mariable Pro?
items.answer: A dedicated Instagram carousel, a partnership announcement story, an article on Mariable.fr, a LinkedIn feature, presence in editorial and SEO selections, and your news relayed in stories on request.

items.question: What exactly does the €149/year Mariable Pro offer include?
items.answer: Mariable Pro includes a professional workspace to manage unlimited weddings, coordinate each wedding day, share the right information with teams and vendors, collaborate with couples and use AI features. Listing and visibility on Mariable.fr can complement this access.

items.question: Why do I need to publish my prices to join Mariable Pro?
items.answer: Because it saves you time: couples know what you offer and what it costs before contacting you. The result is better qualified enquiries, couples aligned with your positioning, and far fewer out-of-budget conversations. You of course keep control of your quotes and bespoke work; published prices simply give the real price range.

items.question: What is the difference between Mariable Pro and Mariable Studio?
items.answer: Mariable Pro is the €149/year working tool for managing and coordinating weddings, with optional Mariable listing. Mariable Studio is bespoke digital marketing support covering strategy, content, social media, advertising and web projects.

items.question: How do I send my pricing?
items.answer: Email your information sheet, your brochure or the link to your website where the information is listed. We analyse it and write your packages up on your profile. Your brochure is not published nor accessible without a request; only your prices are made public.

items.question: Which event professionals do you work with?
items.answer: Venues (estates, châteaux, mas, manors), caterers, photographers and videographers, wedding planners and coordinators, dress, suit and bridal accessories designers. For Mariable Studio, I work more broadly with every event brand looking to professionalise its image and client acquisition.

items.question: Organic growth or paid advertising — which to choose?
items.answer: Both are complementary. Organic (Instagram, TikTok, SEO) builds your brand and credibility long term. Paid (Meta Ads, TikTok Ads) generates qualified leads quickly and lets you test angles. I build a hybrid acquisition strategy based on your digital maturity, your budget and your booking goals.

items.question: How much does a Mariable Studio engagement cost?
items.answer: Studio services start at €400 and are then on quote, because every professional has specific needs (content volume, posting frequency, Meta / TikTok Ads budget, web project). I build à la carte support or a monthly retainer matched to your acquisition strategy.

items.question: Can you build the website for my business?
items.answer: Yes. I design custom showcase and booking websites for event pros: editorial design, SEO, contact forms, photo galleries, availability calendar integration. I also handle redesigns of existing websites.

items.question: Do you work everywhere in France?
items.answer: Yes, I support event pros across mainland France. Shoots and tapings happen on site; community management, paid acquisition and digital development are run remotely with regular check-ins.
